diagnostic_limitations: Entry execution is unmeasured; reported start address is not execution proof. Only observed debug notifications are recorded, not every mapping attempt or a stack. Unresolved module paths cannot prove a named module's absence. Exception fields are recorded only when an exception notification arrives; no stack is captured. The first first-chance breakpoint is assumed to be debugger startup, not address-validated. The collection deadline bounds waits/event-loop checks, not arbitrary native API blocking. Target ISA is not independently checked; native validation is limited to the intended x64 workflow. A successful detach can leave this target running; detach is not a workload stop/reap guarantee. Collection exit zero means successful collection/cleanup, not successful native application launch.

events.pe_entry_note: Reported thread start address, not a measurement of execution; source-level wWinMain is distinct.
